name: Surgical site infection after cranial vault remodeling
summary: Estimates 30-day surgical site infection risk from preoperative factors.
intendedUse: Research and preoperative counseling discussions for children undergoing cranial vault remodeling.
outcome: Surgical site infection (superficial, deep, or organ space) within 30 days of surgery.
development: ACS NSQIP-Pediatric Participant Use Files, 2015–2022; 4,812 patients; 2.1% event rate. Multivariable logistic regression.
limitations: Participating hospitals are not a random sample of all US hospitals.
citation: Author A, et al. Journal. Year;Vol:pages.

inputs.label: Age at surgery
inputs.hint: Coefficient applies per month above 6 months.
